final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT a.translink, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON r.transreg = a.translink COLLATE BINARY JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY a.translink, t.tradekind), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s.translink, s.tradekind, s.record_count, 1.0 * s.record_count / z.total_count AS share FROM step1 AS s CROSS JOIN step2 AS z WHERE z.total_count IS NOT NULL) SELECT tradekind, AVG(record_count), AVG(share) FROM step3 GROUP BY tradekind
